2105-6633-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-6633-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-6633-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2459-5006-5256-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-5256-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

2645-2930-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2026-2645-3430-4717.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3430-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2577-5478-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5478-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5478-5686-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1957-2842-4050--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target player to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

648-1880-6566--147.manaNeeded: {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
648-1880-6566--147.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-1880-6566--147.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield.
Yuna triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Hallar equal to the number the Fractal had.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

618-4681-5686.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4826-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

877-1374-5910-7907.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Glamdring and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

1988-3490-3698-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-3490-3698-7426.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat

1086-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2440-6737-6965-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6737-6965-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

280-1558-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-2438-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2034-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-2876-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating  a token copy of Elenda that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {C}{C}.
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Vampires, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

129-3755-3995.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3755-3995.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2173-2854-4574-4708.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2173-2854-4574-4708.description:
Cast Dark Sphere either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

225-907-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-907-5451-5702.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-907-5451-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

184-4682-4948.notablePrerequisites:
Estrid's Invocation on the battlefield as a copy of Smothering Tithe
You have at least two opponents which are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4682-4948.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe and Estrid's Invocation trigger for each opponent you have, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

1170-2909-6203.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
1170-2909-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-4147-4215-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4147-4215-5231.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

369-4775-5147.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-4775-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1692-2341-2743-2751.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
The Peregrine Dynamo does not have summoning sickness.
1692-2341-2743-2751.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Resolve all Helm of the Host triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1657-2744.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4306-4331-4993.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least five.
4306-4331-4993.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

254-301-2292.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
254-301-2292.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}, causing all creatures that enter the battlefield under your control this turn to get an additional +1/+1 counter put on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
Putrid Goblin's persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering First Day of Class, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 2, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-4170-4338-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
"Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.
2178-4170-4338-4875.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Rotlung Reanimator and Fain.
Resolve the Rotlung Reanimator trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat.
